# lmw notify

Choose where lmw sends notifications: phone, Telegram, Discord...

### Synopsis

Notification channels are where watches (and your AI assistant) tell you
about things. A channel has a name and a target:

  ntfy      a push notification through ntfy.sh (or ntfy:https://your.server/topic)
            ntfy:my-secret-topic
  telegram  a Telegram message from your bot: telegram:BOT_TOKEN:CHAT_ID
            telegram:123456:ABC-token:987654
  discord   a message in a Discord channel, through its webhook
            discord:https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...
  slack     a message in a Slack channel, through its webhook
            slack:https://hooks.slack.com/services/...
  webhook   a JSON POST to your own URL: title, text, url, watch, time
            webhook:https://example.com/hook
  command   a command in your shell, with LMW_TITLE, LMW_TEXT, LMW_URL and LMW_WATCH
            command:notify-send "$LMW_TITLE" "$LMW_TEXT"

Targets can hold tokens: lmw keeps them in a file only you can read, and
lists them masked.
